query:
UPDATE purchase
            SET amount_cents = COALESCE($3, amount_cents),
                purchased_on = COALESCE($4, purchased_on),
                product_type = COALESCE($5, product_type),
                set_code     = COALESCE($6, set_code),
                name         = CASE WHEN $7 THEN $8 ELSE name END
            WHERE id = $1
              AND user_id = $2
